about_the_game:
"I remember that day. I tried to get back to you with all my strength. The more I tried, the more everything washed out to white, I felt like I had... vanished! Am I... lost?"

In a not-too-distant future, a way to connect to the subconscious of people who fall into coma has been found. You are "The Inspector", and your task is to investigate the human mind in search of elements that will bring your patients back to life.

In this narrative-focused experience, you will explore the dreams of patients in coma, locate memories that help wake them up, and escape the sentinels, these organisms who protect the patients’ subconscious.

It seems that the coma traps your patient in a sort of parallel world. No one knows exactly how this is done, as it turns out to be different for each person, shaped by the memories and emotions of oneself.

What is certain, it's that we now know how to wake up from it: it will be necessary to find a series of significant memories, moments so impressed in the character's mind that they are also present in the parallel world that dominates his deep sleep. Memories are often represented in the form of objects.

Good luck, Inspector!

Key Features:

  • A narrative-focused experience for those who favor deep emotions over challenges

  • An atmospheric and non-linear story

  • A rich and stylized environment that rewards players who explore

DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST & FOLLOW!
